title: CertOps Protocol Smoke Job Payload
description: Signed dispatch payload for a diagnostic protocol_smoke job (ADR-0012 decisions 3 and 7). Dispatched ONLY to agents whose server-assigned agent_kind is 'diagnostic' (never client-declared); exists so a Node-free reference client can exercise claim/verify/report without ever being offered certificate work. Composes the shared signedDispatchEnvelope definition (schemaVersion/jobId/workspaceId/agentId/mode/requestedAt plus the signed-dispatch fields) and adds nothing certificate-shaped: no certificateId, target, keyMode, certificatePem, or any key-custody field. additionalProperties: false at every level, so a smoke job can never be mistaken for, or grown into, a certificate job. Unlike job-payload.schema.json (which keeps agentId schema-optional during the server-first rollout described in the ADR, for legacy-tolerance reasons that predate this schema), this schema requires agentId from day one: it is new, so there is no pre-existing deployed client whose tolerance must be preserved.

action.description: Fixed action value. A dedicated wire action, not a reuse of 'noop' (a real production action in EXECUTABLE_JOB_ACTIONS), so a diagnostic client and a production agent never share an action string (ADR-0012 decision 7).

mode.description: protocol_smoke never has a 'real' variant; it is diagnostic-only by construction, not merely by convention.

echo.description: Operator-supplied opaque string the diagnostic client's result should echo back, so a manual smoke test can visually confirm round-trip integrity without inspecting server state.
